tooltips.destination: Destination whose operating account owns this conversion action.
tooltips.conversionActionId: Numeric conversion action ID owned by the destination's operating account. Enter digits only, without hyphens.
tooltips.includeOnCreate: Upload a conversion when an Opportunity is created directly in this stage, not only when it moves into the stage later.
tooltips.includeUserData: Include normalized and hashed first-party contact data for enhanced conversions for leads when consent permits.
tooltips.lookbackDays: Maximum age, in days, of click attribution accepted for this mapping.
tooltips.valueSource: Select whether conversion value comes from the Opportunity or the fixed value below.
tooltips.fixedValue: Value used when Value Source is fixed.
tooltips.currencySource: Select whether currency comes from the Opportunity or the fixed currency below.
tooltips.fixedCurrency: ISO 4217 currency code used when Currency Source is fixed.
